original_digest_algorithm: SHA256(json.dumps(rows before second turn_context, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True).encode()) ; JSON default separators, one JSON array, no trailing newline
scope_boundary: This prefix includes first creation turn and subsequent inter-turn event markers before the second turn_context. Model/tool/image proof refers to exact first-turn calls and ImageView entries, not a claim that every prefix event is creation-only. No later verifier call included.
